name: Personal Demons
source:
Set during his pre-transition years, Carmara has been stalked by a man named Ferrum ever since their fateful, terrifying encounter on the subway. After forcing Carmara’s hand into letting him intrude upon his life, Ferrum has been influencing him to "take back what the world owes him". Unfortunately, the path he chooses requires tarnishing his pristine image, and it all starts with a small act of deception...

[From [url=https://nocturnenebula.itch.io/personal-demons]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在卡马拉转型前的几年里，自从他们在地铁上发生了致命而可怕的遭遇后，卡马拉就一直被一个名叫费鲁姆的男人跟踪。在迫使卡马拉介入他的生活后，费鲁姆一直在影响他“夺回世界欠他的东西”。不幸的是，他选择的道路却毁掉了他原本的形象，而这一切都始于一个小小的欺骗行为……

[来自[url=https://nocturnenebula.itch.io/personal-demons]itch.io[/url]]
